name: Feifan UI Contract

semantics.MUST: required for new or changed UI; exceptions require documented scope and reason

rules.requirement: Use shared semantic tokens and components inside the plugin theme root; centralize host adaptation and remove superseded rules.
Use the approved four color roles and neutral support only; do not create chromatic tints or page palettes.
verify: computed color audit including pseudo-elements and charts

rules.requirement: Resolve one effective mode; keep text and necessary controls readable in each mode, including portals and photo overlays.
Use opaque content surfaces; remove decorative nested frames while retaining necessary field and focus boundaries.
Use shared dimensions and stable geometry; never scale typography down with viewport width.
Keep one primary command per action group and consistent P0/P1/P2/P3 recipes; accompany color with text or icons.
Associate permanent labels and errors; constrain shrinkable fields and intrinsic-width menus to the viewport.
Provide named tools, keyboard access, visible focus and correct modal/menu lifecycles in the owning document.
Notify queued local changes promptly without claiming durable success; preserve save verification and propagate failures.
Respect reduced motion and measure input-to-visible-feedback separately from persistence.
verify: representative latency samples with environment and data size

rules.requirement: Divide overview module entries equally in one row without a partially empty second row.
Place habits first, heat and progress second, full-width trend last; preserve title spacing and stack below 700px.
Group each ledger's five metrics in one neutral surface without individual decorative frames.
verify: personal and business ledger visual review

rules.requirement: Keep eight main modules; do not restore token UI or scans; preserve historical business fields.
Bundle offline licensed photos with source records and readable overlays; retain solid and custom options without losing custom paths; do not derive UI palettes from photos.
Provide a new-review command and shared opaque form; open existing same-date notes without overwriting; show durable creation results and retain input on failure.

knownGaps: complete async pending and error coverage
